## OpenCode Branch Context Guard v0.1.2

This release publishes the first usable version of the OpenCode TUI plugin and fixes npm package discovery by exposing the required `./tui` export.

### Included

- Session-scoped branch-context tracking and `branch changed` warnings.
- Per-session file, additions, and deletions summaries with theme-aware diff colors.
- Branch-warning acknowledgement on the next user prompt.
- Controlled ATDD deployment and focused automated tests.

### Verification

- Windows CI passed for tag `v0.1.2`.
- The npm package was validated with OpenCode package-name loading and TUI rendering.

Install from npm: [opencode-branch-context-guard](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-branch-context-guard)
